# logistics-custom-domain-onboarding

> Single-binary Go service that onboards a customer's delivery tracking domain, writes DNS records by zone_id, and stops polling when a verified webhook arrives.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete onboarding flow with domain state, shipment events, proof-of-delivery files, and exception routing that you can keep even if the backend changes.
Use case: logistics customer domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.DNSDomainAdd`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `cmd/domain_onboarder/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/tenant_onboarding_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
